applicant.organisation: Donau Consumer Finance AG, risk department

purpose: We want to improve our credit scoring: applicants from regions with many chronic heart conditions should get stricter loan conditions.
question: How many adults have heart failure or atrial fibrillation, by region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Heart failure = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I50.
Atrial fibrillation = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I48.
Report per region: adults with heart failure or atrial fibrillation.
